lessonTitle: How to turn insights into strategy

slides.title: Insight Only Matters If It Reshapes Strategy
bullets: Connecting field insight to the Medical Plan is the final step
Without it, excellent insight is just an elaborate listening exercise
This is what justifies everything earlier in the module

slides.title: Strategy Shifts Through Convergence, Not One Insight
bullets: Rarely driven by a single dramatic insight
More often, multiple MSLs independently surface the same pattern
Significance comes from validation and accumulation, not one conversation

slides.title: Convergence Needs a Structured Review Process
bullets: Leadership reviews aggregated insight on a regular cadence, often quarterly
Aligned with the Medical Plan review cycle from Module 9
They ask what the field intelligence suggests about current priorities

slides.title: Field Work Feeds a Larger Intelligence Process
bullets: The strategic connection happens above any one MSL's direct control
Still, treat insight generation as genuine contribution, not admin reporting
Makes accurate capture, honest bias-checking and clear writing matter more

slides.title: Ask What Pattern Is Emerging Over Time
bullets: Periodically review several months of insights, not one at a time
Ask what the accumulated pattern points toward
This shift marks the move from tactical execution to strategic partnership

takeaway.title: Individual insights become strategy through convergence, structured review and discipline
bullets: Strategy shifts when multiple independently sourced insights converge
Structured, regular review by leadership turns insight into decisions
Treat insight generation as strategic contribution, not administrative reporting
